If $\varphi $ and the exhaustion $\psi _k$ above are uniformly Lipschitz, then \[ \lim _{k o \infty }\int _{M_\infty } \varphi \psi _k riangle e^{-l_\infty } \, d\vol _{g_\infty } \] converges absolutely. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Integrate by parts. The integrand becomes $\langle abla (\varphi \psi _k), abla l_\infty angle e^{-l_\infty }$, which is integrable because $| abla l_\infty |\leq \max (1,| abla l_\infty |^2)$ and the previous claim applies.

□

Corollary
